items.meeting: **The meeting.** {carrierFirstName} contacts you to set the date and exact location ({pickupLocation}).
items.handover: **The parcel handover.** {carrierFirstName} will inspect the content, take their photos, then confirm pickup in the app.
items.codeArrives: **Your code arrives.** As soon as {carrierFirstName} confirms pickup, you receive your 6-digit code. You forward it to {recipientFirstName} (WhatsApp, SMS, voice).
items.delivery: **The delivery.** {recipientFirstName} shares the code with {carrierFirstName} on arrival. He enters it in the app, delivery is validated.
items.verification: **Verification period.** 3 days during which you can report any issue if needed.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.confirm: **If you confirm now**, {carrierFirstName} receives his payment immediately. Appreciated, quick gesture.
howItWorks.nothing: **If you do nothing**, the payment is released automatically after 3 days.
howItWorks.nothingShort: **You do nothing** = automatic payment at D+4.
howItWorks.report: **If you report an issue**, the payment is frozen and we start a mediation. Our team replies within 48 business hours.

payment.noteReleased: You confirmed the delivery — the funds are being transferred to {carrierFirstName}.

report.title: Report an issue
report.subtitle: Deal {originCity} → {destinationCity} · delivered on {date}

banner.title: We''re here to help
banner.text: Tell us what happened, we''ll take care of the rest. While we review the case, {carrierFirstName}''s payment stays blocked.
banner.textShort: Tell us, we''ll handle the rest. {carrierFirstName}''s payment frozen.

report.h1Subtitle: The more details and evidence you give us, the faster we can decide.
report.h1SubtitleShort: The more details you give, the faster we decide.

category.title: What''s the problem?
category.sub: Pick the situation that fits best
category.NOT_DELIVERED: The parcel was never delivered to {recipientFirstName}
category.CONTENT_MISSING: Content missing or different from the declaration
category.RECIPIENT_ISSUE: {recipientFirstName} has another issue with the traveller

description.title: Tell us what happened
description.sub: Be specific: when did you find out, who contacted you, what''s missing or wrong
description.subShort: When you found out, what''s missing or wrong
description.placeholder: E.g.: {recipientFirstName} called me this morning to tell me the navy sweater I declared wasn''t in the parcel. One of the t-shirts is also torn at the collar…

photos.title: Add photos
photos.sub: Photos of the received content, the damage, or anything that helps us understand
photos.subShort: Of the received content, the damage
photos.hint: Ask {recipientFirstName} to send you photos if she can. Up to {max} photos, max 10 MB each.

outcome.title: Your preferred outcome
outcome.sub: Help us understand what feels fair to you — we''ll review your request
outcome.PARTIAL_REFUND: Partial refund for the missing/damaged items
outcome.YAMBA_DECIDES: I''ll let Yamba decide based on the evidence

process.title: What happens after your report
process.step1: **You receive an acknowledgement within 48 business hours.** Our team takes over your case.
process.step2: **We contact {carrierFirstName}** to get his side of the story and his evidence (pickup photos, etc).
process.step3: **We decide within 5 business days.** You receive our decision by email with the details. If you disagree, mediation is possible with a certified mediator.
process.step3Short: **Decision within 5 business days**, mediation possible if you disagree.
process.step4: **During the entire review**, {carrierFirstName}''s payment stays frozen. Nothing is paid out before resolution.

pledge.text: I declare on my honour that the information provided is accurate. I understand that an abusive report may lead to contractual consequences.
pledge.textShort: I declare on my honour that the information provided is accurate.
pledge.whyText: A report freezes a real person''s payment. This commitment protects honest Trippers — just like the Charter commits them to your parcel.

cta.info: Once sent, your report can no longer be modified. Our team will contact you within 48h.
cta.infoShort: Once sent, your report can no longer be modified.
cta.confirmText: {carrierFirstName}''s payment will be frozen and our mediation team will take over. This action is irreversible.
